description: Notes before #START count toward neither voiceValue, judging nor scoredLineCount, so a perfect run from #START scores 10000; a Note starting exactly at #START is scored
comment: #START 1.0 s is the start of Beat 4. The Note at Beat 0 starts before it and is left out; the Notes at Beats 4 and 6 are scored: voiceValue = 2 + 1 = 3, 3000 per hit Beat. Beats 0 and 1 are not judged even though the Player sang them. Line 0 has only a Note before #START, so it is no scored Line: scoredLineCount = 1 and Line 1 (lineMax 9000, perfect) takes the whole 1000.
